# Creating a Flow on Webex Connect

Source: https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/create-a-new-flow
Documentation version: 6.20.0
Retrieved: 2026-09-08T23:28:41+00:00

## Step 1 - Add a New Flow

1. Click **Create Blank Flow** button under the Flows section on the service dashboard. 



![Creating a Blank Flow using Services Dashboard](https://files.readme.io/75a2d14-4.jpg)




Alternatively, click **Flows ** tab (shown below), and then click either of the two **Create Flow** buttons.



![Creating a Blank Flow using Flows](https://files.readme.io/6be742d-5.jpeg)




2. Enter the Flow Name and choose the **Type **as WorkFlow. You can select 'Voice Flow' in case you want to build a voice flow.

3. In the **Method** dropdown, select the **New Flow** option.

4. Select **Start from Scratch** option to create a flow from the beginning and click on **Create **to proceed further. 

In case you would like to build an SMS survey, appointment reminder flow, or an autoresponder flow you can select one of the pre-built templates and get a head start.



![Creating a Flow popup](https://files.readme.io/f0cf650-9.jpg)




5. Once done, you will arrive at the **Select Trigger Category** page where you can configure how this flow will be triggered. You can pick from the displayed trigger categories e.g. channel triggers, system triggers, or custom triggers.



![Select Trigger Category window](https://files.readme.io/3e716c7-1.jpeg)




From here on, you can follow one of the below end-to-end tutorials. 

- [Sending automated SMS using Webex Connect Visual Flow Builder](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/sending-automated-sms-using-imiconnect-visual-flow-builder)
- [Setting up an Appointment Reminder in Webex Connect](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/setting-up-an-appointment-reminder-in-imiconnect)
